?

Find the inverse Laplace transform for F(s)=9(s−4)(s+5).

a
L−1{F(s)}=e4t+e−5t
b
L−1{F(s)}=−e−4t+e5t
c
L−1{F(s)}=−e4t+e−5t
d
L−1{F(s)}=4et−5e−4t
e
